title: Advanced Socio-Economic Engine — implementation
summary: Replace the simple annual-feedback model with a richer multi-channel socio-economic engine (labour, productivity, education, housing, NHS, welfare, crime, long-term effects) supporting conservative/moderate/optimistic forecast modes and explicit uncertainty. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: The simple feedback model is replaced behind the engine interface
All listed channels are modelled and documented with sources
Conservative/moderate/optimistic modes produce coherent, ordered outputs
Uncertainty is represented explicitly in outputs
Scoring consumes the new engine deterministically per mode
notes:
Scope (in): Channels: labour participation, productivity, education, housing, NHS demand, welfare, crime, long-term economic effects, uncertainty modelling; Forecast modes: conservative, moderate, optimistic
Out of scope: Distributional/by-group breakdowns (EPIC-013); Monte Carlo simulation tooling (EPIC-014)
